# reac-repacer / fuzz_egress

reac-repacer's own fuzz target `fuzz_egress` ([source](source/fuzz_egress.c), unmodified), which OSS-Fuzz does not run, over reac-repacer 0.2.3 (FreeREAC/reac-repacer at 3ac1cf10).

Takes a slot byte, a 32-bit output counter, twelve 32-bit samples and then a frame of at most 1600 bytes. It runs every write the daemon makes into a frame it emits: the counter restamp, the mute used during a rate change, the gate that decides whether a frame holds the injected slot, and the slot sample writer. It compares each resulting frame with one the harness builds itself from the REAC frame layout.

## How this program differs from a libFuzzer build of this fuzz target
- Linked against a static library of src/repace_wire.c and src/repace_conf.c, and one of libreac's src/reac.c, the files reac-repacer's own libFuzzer build compiles; built as a static riscv64 program for the standard driver in place of libFuzzer.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the fuzz target one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- After a restamp, a frame of 18 bytes or more carries the low 16 bits of the counter at bytes 14-15, little-endian, and every other byte is unchanged ([lines 39-61](source/fuzz_egress.c#L39-L61)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- The mute zeroes an audio frame of more than 18 bytes from byte 18 to its end and keeps bytes 0-17; any other frame is unchanged ([lines 63-87](source/fuzz_egress.c#L63-L87)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- The gate answers the frame's width exactly when the frame is audio and its width, by the frame law, holds the slot, and -1 otherwise ([lines 97-107](source/fuzz_egress.c#L97-L107)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- The writer writes exactly when the gate lets it; the frame then carries the low 24 bits of each sample at the braid bytes for that slot and time-sample, and every other byte is unchanged ([lines 109-141](source/fuzz_egress.c#L109-L141)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
